A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FedTA research. Their complete text, equations, tables, and figures support comparison despite the changed title and layout. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-R experiments, including accuracy comparisons, component ablations, knowledge-retention curves, and feature visualizations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and reports additional baseline knowledge-retention curves in Figure 4.

M1.justification: The frozen ViT, input enhancement, tail-anchor optimization, knowledge fusion, and prototype selection remain the same. v2 expands the distillation description beyond v1's explicitly illustrative two-base case and corrects inconsistent freezing wording; these do not establish a different underlying procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate class-incremental learning on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-R under the same client heterogeneity scenarios. No additional dataset, task, or test environment is evaluated.

E2.justification: Figure 4 adds FedNova and FedMGP to all four knowledge-retention comparisons. Both already appeared in Table 1, whose eleven-baseline membership remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain five clients, five tasks, the same private/public class allocations, Dirichlet allocation of public-class data, and surrogate sample counts. Accuracy and both knowledge-retention metrics are unchanged; no revised experimental protocol is stated.

E4.justification: The same three component ablations, forgetting visualizations in Figure 2, and Figure 5 sensitivity visualizations remain. Figure 5 retains the combinations of 10/100 input enhancements and 100/500 tail anchors. No new ablation or robustness question is tested.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The additional curves retain the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Table 1 are identical. Figure 4 adds FedNova and FedMGP retention results and changes TARGET's final CIFAR-100 spatial-retention value from roughly 120 to 90. The other existing retention curves, including FedTA and its ablations, are unchanged after accounting for colors and scaling.

T1.justification: Equation 8 replaces the illustrative two-base MSE expression with an explicit mean over the other n−1 knowledge bases. This is a limited generalization of the written loss definition. The remaining mathematical framework is retained, with no new theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: Both claim that FedTA addresses parameter-forgetting and output-forgetting through four components, outperforms existing FCL methods, and preserves relative feature positions. Rewritten introductory and concluding passages retain this contribution scope.

C2.justification: The forgetting mechanism and interpretations of baseline and ablation results remain substantially unchanged. Both retain the insufficient-surrogate-data explanation for SIKF's weaknesses and the privacy concern about uploaded prototypes. The added anchor analogy illustrates an existing explanation.

D1.justification: v2 newly specifies random selection of the distillation student and clarifies input-enhancement querying and loss terms. It also removes v1's explicit statement that the ViT was pretrained on ImageNet-21K. These are documentation changes, without evidence of changed experimental settings.

R1.justification: v2 adds five cited works, including FedProK and federated-foundation-model challenges, and removes the one-pass distribution-sketch citation. It also removes the paragraph individually describing FedWeIT, GLFC, TARGET, and MFCL, while retaining the central novelty positioning.

P1.justification: The title and several introductory, methodological, and concluding passages are revised. v2 adds explanatory summaries, a corresponding-author designation, and acknowledgments, while shortening some background text. The main section sequence and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: The entire document changes from a single-column to a two-column layout. Figure 1 gains an anchor-intuition panel, Figure 4 changes from a horizontal strip to a 2×2 arrangement with revised legends, colors, and axis ranges, and Figure 3 corrects an equation reference. Figures and Table 1 are extensively repositioned and resized.

improvement.justification: Clearer querying and distillation descriptions, removal of contradictory freezing wording, and the added intuition panel improve understanding. Adding FedNova and FedMGP to the retention comparisons improves comparative completeness. These are modest gains, partly offset by removing the explicit ImageNet-21K pretraining specification.
